_doc: Declarative edits applied to generated screens. A patch replaces the text from `start` through `end` (both must occur exactly once). `$ORIGINAL` in `replace` is the replaced text. If the prototype changes so a patch no longer matches, generation fails loudly.

patches.name: real video player (falls back to the prototype's placeholder when there is no real video)
patches.end: {"Preview placeholder — the generated clip plays here"}

patches.name: working Download MP4 link when there is a real video
patches.replace: {v.downloadUrl ? ({"Download MP4"}) : (<>$ORIGINAL)}
